owner_answer: Measure first, then approve numeric targets (Recommended)

sequence: Measure recovery on supported reference deployments
Present source-bound measurements and proposed numeric RPO and RTO limits
Obtain owner approval before production readiness
contract.permission: Missing independent security or budget history keeps affected admission restricted regardless of a recovery objective.

measurement_limits: Component test duration is not deployment RTO.
A laboratory zero-loss result is not a blanket production RPO guarantee.
Record outage start, restored readiness, restored acknowledged state, hardware, topology, load, backup/history age, fencing and native identities.
